name: Cursor Demo
description: Presentation mode for your cursor: a glowing highlight ring, a fading motion trail, and click ripples so your audience can always see where the pointer is. Great for screen-sharing and demos.
author: Coco

subtitle.en: Highlight the cursor with a glowing trail for presentations
subtitle.zh: 为演示高亮光标并显示运行轨迹

preferences.title: Highlight color
preferences.description: Color of the ring, trail, and click ripples.

preferences.title: Ring size
preferences.description: Diameter of the highlight ring drawn around the cursor.

preferences.title: Trail length
preferences.description: How long the motion trail lingers behind the cursor.

preferences.title: Click ripples
preferences.description: Show an expanding ripple wherever you click.

preferences.title: Spotlight
preferences.description: Dim the rest of the screen and keep a bright circle around the cursor.
